original_test_intent: Execute the approved NVIDIA Partner Manufacturing Diagnostics against the exact Blackwell HGX 8-GPU manufacturing specification for this platform and prove every defined hardware module passes without hang, reboot or unexplained GPU/NVLink/PCIe/platform error.
original_method: Verify partnerdiag executable and spec file independently by version/hash/signature/provenance; parse the spec schema, target SKU/revision, included modules, parameters, limits and exclusions and compare them with the physical HGX 8-GPU topology/firmware; drain the SUT and preserve a comprehensive baseline; run the exact source command once under continuous power/thermal/interconnect monitoring; retain all per-item artifacts and every failure continued by --run_on_error; account for --no_bmc as excluded coverage; recover under vendor direction without spec substitution or automatic rerun.
manual_activity: Owner/NVIDIA manufacturing engineer supplies and approves the signed package/spec pair and exact target mapping; an operator isolates and monitors the platform and owns emergency recovery.
required_inputs: Authentic partnerdiag binary/package version/hash/signature/license and dependencies
Exact spec_blackwell-hgx-8-gpu_partner_mfg.json version/hash/signature/schema, target SKU/revision and module/parameter/limit manifest
HGX Blackwell board identity, eight GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe topology and compatible firmware/driver matrix
Maintenance authorization, thermal/power/interconnect aborts, durable storage, no-BMC disposition and NVIDIA recovery path
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated idle SUT with verified power/cooling and console/BMC recovery
Reject package/spec mismatch, unknown schema or target incompatibility before execution
Use trusted access and preserve all logs/counters; monitor broad hardware and thermal/power state throughout
Retain all earlier failures under --run_on_error and stop only at approved emergency thresholds, hang or reboot
Do not substitute a nearby spec, truncate output, clear evidence or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify package and spec provenance plus exact target/schema/module mapping
Run exactly partnerdiag --mfg --run_spec=spec_blackwell-hgx-8-gpu_partner_mfg.json --run_on_error --no_bmc once under approved monitoring
Capture every module result/artifact and correlated GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/platform health
Do not infer spec compatibility from filename, claim BMC coverage, hide earlier failure, rerun automatically or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the signed package/spec revisions and exact Blackwell HGX 8-GPU SKU/topology/firmware compatibility
Approve module/parameter/limit and continuation semantics, no-BMC disposition, aborts and recovery
Review the full manufacturing artifact set and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH SPEC-BOUND BLACKWELL HGX 8-GPU MANUFACTURING DIAGNOSTICS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the executable and JSON as a signed qualification pair, validate every spec module against the physical SKU and topology, and produce a module-indexed evidence ledger that retains failures despite continuation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds binary/spec supply-chain identity, schema and target validation, full module/parameter traceability, broad telemetry, scope accounting and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A familiar spec filename or final output excerpt can conceal a stale/wrong target spec, skipped modules, overridden limits, earlier failures or absent BMC coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Manufacturing diagnostics exercise most HGX hardware concurrently; a mismatched spec can apply incorrect loads or limits, and --run_on_error can compound stress after an item fails.

project_override_considerations: A different spec file or partnerdiag build may be used only with explicit NVIDIA/owner compatibility mapping and preserved module-equivalence evidence. Generic field diagnostics do not replace manufacturing coverage; BMC remains separate while --no_bmc is retained.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and partnerdiag package version/hash/signature/license
Exact JSON spec version/hash/signature/schema, target SKU/revision and parsed module/parameter/limit manifest
Physical board/eight-GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe topology and firmware/driver compatibility comparison
Exact command/environment/timestamps/exit status, complete stdout/stderr and all module artifacts including first and continued failures
GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/driver/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/thermal/power pre/during/post evidence and explicit no-BMC gap
Abort/recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Makes the manufacturing result depend on a verified binary/spec pair and exact physical target, retains all continuing failures, and prevents filename-based compatibility or truncated evidence claims.
independent_technical_reasoning: The JSON spec is executable test policy: it selects modules, loads and limits, so a wrong but similarly named file can invalidate coverage or create risk. Verification must bind its hash/schema and target metadata to the actual eight-GPU platform before the binary runs. Because --run_on_error can execute later modules after failure, a final completion cannot override any earlier failed item; complete module-indexed artifacts and health telemetry are the acceptance basis.
